test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
**Directions: **Study the following information carefully to answer the given questions:

M @ N means M is the wife of N

M # N means M is the son of N

M % N means M is the Sister of N 

M $ M means M is the father of N

In the expression "K % L # E $ F" how is L related to F?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 #
 %
 $
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Son
 Sister
 Father
 
 

Given: K % L # E $ F

It means: K is Sister of L, L is Son of E, E is Father of F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60f08e1d509d63beb57add8c1836885310161326268f9ad2aa4feda0cb4334aa.png] 

 

Thus, L is Brother of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
